# DataForSEO fixtures

Sanitized responses used by the endpoint tests. Field names and nesting follow the official
DataForSEO client types (`dataforseo-client` 2.x; the AI Optimization and Google AI Mode
fixtures follow 2.1.7) and the v3 documentation; values, including the AI answers, are
illustrative. Domains are `example.*` except for well-known public sites that appear in
Google results.

When a response is recorded from the live API to extend these fixtures, remove the login,
task IDs of real accounts and anything account-specific before committing it.
